title: Present Continuous: Form
grammarNote:
Present Continuous (Настоящее продолженное время) — мы используем его, чтобы описать действие, которое происходит ПРЯМО СЕЙЧАС, в момент речи.

В казахском языке ему соответствует -п жатыр (жазып жатыр = пишет прямо сейчас). В русском — настоящее время с акцентом на "прямо сейчас" (читает, пишет, идёт).

📐 Формула:
[Подлежащее] + [am / is / are] + [глагол + -ing]

Примеры из чтения про Амира:
"I am sitting in the WKU library right now." → Я сижу в библиотеке прямо сейчас.
"Sholpan is eating lunch in the cafeteria." → Шолпан ест обед в кафетерии.
"They are arguing about a maths problem." → Они спорят о задаче по математике.
"The printer is making a loud noise." → Принтер издаёт громкий шум.

⚙️ Выбор am / is / are зависит от подлежащего:
→ I → AM
→ He / She / It → IS
→ You / We / They → ARE

Важно помнить:
✅ "He IS reading." (не "He are reading")
✅ "We ARE studying." (не "We is studying")
✅ "I AM working." (не "I is working")

rows.example: "I'm writing the code for our project." — Amir (= I am writing)
"He's eating porridge and reading a textbook." — Bekzat (= He is)
"She's highlighting sentences with a marker." — Malika (= She is)
"They're arguing about a maths problem." (= They are arguing)
"We're both being terrible students today!" — Malika to Aigerim.
✅ "I'm not sleeping." ❌ "I amn't sleeping." — такой формы не существует!

grammarExtra.title: Negative — отрицание: am not / isn't / aren't

rows.example: "I am not attending a lecture at this moment." — Amir. Нет краткой формы!
"She isn't looking at anyone." — девушка с наушниками. (= is not)
"We aren't studying seriously." — Malika и Aigerim. (= are not)

rows.form: is not = isn't · are not = aren't
rows.example: "He is not sleeping." = "He isn't sleeping." — оба варианта правильны.
❌ "He not is working." ❌ "He is not working not." → ✅ "He isn't working."
✅ "I am NOT writing." ✅ "She IS NOT reading." ❌ "NOT she is reading."

grammarExtra.title: Questions — вопросы: Am I? / Is he? / Are they?

rows.example: "Am I speaking too fast?" · "What am I doing wrong?" — вопрос от первого лица.
"Is the barista making a cappuccino?" — Aigerim asks Malika.
"Are you coming to the library after lunch?" — Amir asks Sholpan.
"Are you studying?" → "Yes, I am." / "No, I'm not." (Never "Yes, I'm.")
"What are you doing?" · "What is the professor writing?" · "What am I doing?"
"Who is sleeping near the window?" · "Who is arguing next to you, Malika?"
work → working · read → reading · study → studying · talk → talking · play → playing

sit → sitting · run → running · swim → swimming · get → getting · stop → stopping
read → reading (не readding!) · sleep → sleeping · wait → waiting
lie → lying · die → dying · tie → tying

grammarTip:
Три шага — и Present Continuous всегда правильный:

① Определи подлежащее → выбери am / is / are:
   I → AM · He/She/It → IS · You/We/They → ARE
   "I AM working." · "She IS reading." · "They ARE arguing."

② Проверь окончание -ing (4 правила):
   Обычный глагол → + ing: work → working
   Оканчивается на -e → убери -e: write → writing
   Краткий (согл.+гласн.+согл.) → удвой: sit → sitting
   Оканчивается на -ie → -ying: lie → lying

③ Для отрицания → NOT после am/is/are:
   "She IS NOT reading." = "She ISN'T reading."
   Для вопроса → am/is/are перед подлежащим:
   "IS she reading?" · "ARE they working?" · "AM I late?"

💡 Запомни через Амира:
"I AM sitting in the library. Sholpan IS eating lunch. They ARE working. The printer IS making a noise. Dastan ISN'T helping — he IS playing football!"

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form of "to be".
exercises.text: Right now, I ___ writing code for my Computer Science project.
exercises.hint: I → AM. "I am writing code right now." (not "I is" or "I are")

exercises.text: Look! Malika ___ highlighting sentences in her book.
exercises.hint: Malika = She → IS. "She is highlighting sentences." (He/She/It → is)

exercises.instruction: Write the correct -ing form of the verb.
exercises.text: Amir is ___ (sit) in the library on the second floor.
exercises.hint: sit → short verb (s-i-t: consonant-vowel-consonant) → double the last letter! sit → sitting.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct -ing form of the verb.
exercises.text: The professor is ___ (write) something on the whiteboard.
exercises.hint: write → ends in -e → drop the -e, add -ing: write → writing.

exercises.text: Dastan ___ the project — he is playing football outside.
exercises.hint: Dastan = He → IS NOT helping. (= isn't helping). NOT goes after IS.

exercises.text: "Are you coming to the library?" — "Yes, I'm." is a correct short answer.
exercises.hint: "Yes, I'm." is WRONG — never use a contraction in a short answer! → "Yes, I AM." ✅

exercises.text: You want to ask: "What is Sholpan doing right now?"
exercises.hint: Question word + IS/ARE + subject + verb-ing: "What IS Sholpan DOING?" ✅

exercises.instruction: Which sentence has the correct -ing spelling?
opts: The students are studing in the library.
Malika is makeing coffee right now.
Dastan is runing across the courtyard.
Amir is having a break between lectures.
exercises.correct: Amir is having a break between lectures.
